multi_tu_tray/node.rationale: Pristine upstream b9aeedcb4 does not terminate: `Ctype_aux.are_compatible` recurses forever on the self-referential `struct node` defined in two TUs (draft 37, TRUE BUG; rc 124 at the mirrored 30 s bound, empty stdout/stderr; 60 s in the draft's verbatim runs). The fork carries ONLY the assumed-compatible-list fix (record 2026-09-10, draft 37 "Fork status"), so its are_compatible terminates and the PEmemberof(struct) guard — upstream's exact-tag text, restored 2026-10-03 when draft 38's compatibility consult was reverted ([USER 2026-10-03] mirror-upstream ruling) — rejects the cross-TU value loudly: verbatim `Error {msg: "ill-formed program: `PEmemberof(struct) ==> mismatched tags: Symbol(531, SD_Id("node")) vs Symbol(502, SD_Id("node"))'"}` rc 1. This is the answer pristine itself gives on every other cross-TU struct-value case of the tray (arr-1-2-return, arr-2-2-return, ...), i.e. what upstream would print once its non-termination is fixed; gcc exits 7. Class shared-model-fix (draft 37 alone): the one of the two pristine-side incompletes this register admits (with coverage/alignas/alignas-001, tray 47); the row retires when upstream fixes draft 37. LADDER Tier A row 6b pins fork OCaml == Lean on the same input (under its failure-class symbol projection).

minimal/112-allocator-exhausted-single-r.rationale: `q = malloc(1); p = malloc((size_t)((uintptr_t)q - 7)); return (int)((uintptr_t)p & 0xff);` — ONE request larger than the cursor by 1 byte (malloc_proxy's 8-byte argument temporary puts the cursor at a - 8 and the request is a - 7 bytes, so z = last_address - sz = -1; IvMaxAlignment = 8; the part-two pre-merge audit corrected the earlier "by 7 bytes"). Pristine upstream b9aeedcb4 (memory/concrete/impl_mem.ml:1254, the truncating-division idiom `z - (if q < 0 then -m else m)` over the EUCLIDEAN quomod = ediv_rem, :9) ADDS the remainder to the negative z and SUCCEEDS at address z' = -1 + 7 = 6: an ACTIVE allocation that is NOT 8-aligned and whose object ends ABOVE the cursor (overlapping the live argument temporary) — `Defined {value: "Specified(6)", stdout: "", stderr: "", blocked: "false"}` rc 0, against C11 §7.22.3#1 (suitably aligned; disjoint from any other object). The fork (remedy 1: the out-of-memory kill BEFORE rounding) and Lean answer `Error {msg: "MerrOther "Concrete.allocator: failed (out of memory)""}` rc 1. The idiom is ORIGINAL, not a regression: at upstream adee05e5a^ (before the 2026-05-19 commit "Remove indirect use of Z through Lem's Nat_big_num") the allocator read `let (q,m) = quomod z align in let z' = sub z (if less q zero then negate m else m)` with N = Nat_big_num, whose quomod = Big_int.quomod_big_int is ALSO Euclidean (Big_int.quomod_big_int (-1) 4 = (-1, 3); (-5) 4 = (-2, 3)); the 2026-05 refactor to Z.ediv_rem preserved the behaviour exactly — present since the allocator was written; not introduced by the 2026-05 Z refactor. Class shared-model-fix (allocator-soundness slice C1, remedy 1 of draft 44; [USER 2026-09-16] "unambiguously wrong … allowed to fix ahead of upstream"); found OBSERVABLE at upstream's bound by the part-one pre-merge audit (M1). The row retires when upstream takes the fix. The owning fork-vs-Lean lane (test_exec.sh) records the file CERB_SKIP — an oracle-side `Error` is a non-comparison in its taxonomy; Lean = fork (the same Error line) is evidenced by the three-engine report and the record.

coverage/alignas/alignas-001-self-char.c.rationale: `struct A { _Alignas(struct A) char c; };` — the type form of _Alignas names the struct being defined, which is incomplete until its closing brace (C11 §6.7.2.3#4). Pristine upstream b9aeedcb4 does not terminate (rc 124 at the mirrored 30 s bound, empty stdout/stderr): the character-member shortcut stores AlignType(struct A) unexamined and alignof(struct A) then recurses through its own member (draft 47). The fork answers `tests/coverage/alignas/alignas-001-self-char.c:6:36: error: constraint violation: invalid application of '_Alignof' to an incomplete type 'struct A'` rc 1. Class shared-model-fix (the completeness half of P2d-3 only, taken 2026-10-03 on branch fix/mirror-upstream-d38-alignas from record branch fix/alignas-p2d3 cf4af48f8; [USER 2026-09-27] F-A2 "yes, 'constraint violation' - and this goes in the tray if it isn't there already"): cabs_to_ail.lem desugar_alignment_specifier now applies C11 §6.5.3.4#1 sentence 2 (via §6.7.5#5) to the type form, reusing AlignofInvalidApplication, exactly as genTyping.lem's AilEalignof check. The fork's oracle prints the diagnostic on stderr with no batch verdict, exit 1; the Lean port refuses at the same location (`Error {msg: "desugaring failed at <same loc>"}` rc 1 in batch mode, cause DESUGAR ConstraintViolation; record three-engine table). gcc 13.3 rejects it. The tests/coverage row is CERB_SKIP in test_exec.sh (an oracle refusal without a batch verdict is a non-comparison there). The row retires when upstream fixes draft 47. A pristine-side timeout is admitted only through this cited class.
